contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Swipe Navigation Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Swipe navigation settings

actions.description: It will let you choose navigation type

steps: Select your preferred navigation type between Buttons and Swipe gestures.
Optionally toggle on Gesture hint to display guidance lines at the bottom of the screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open navigation bar settings under Display
actionableDeeplink.message: choose navigation type in Display settings

actions.description: It will disable all third party apps

steps: Press and hold the Power button.
Touch and hold the Power off icon.
Tap Safe mode to reboot and test gesture behavior.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touch Sensitivity Configuration
contexts.title: Touch screen sensitivity

actions.description: It will increase touch screen responsiveness

steps: Scroll down and toggle on Touch sensitivity.
